meaning: to watch someone or something carefully so that nothing bad happens to it
example: Please keep an eye on my bag while I buy a drink.

wrong_meanings.meaning: to close your eyes and go to sleep
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: The idiom is about watching carefully, not about sleeping
This is the opposite of the idiom, which means protecting something

wrong_meanings.meaning: to buy a new pair of glasses
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: This is a literal misreading of the word 'eye'; the idiom has nothing to do with glasses

explanation: 'Keep an eye on' means to watch someone or something carefully. Use it when you ask someone to look after your things.
